Container.Name: May
Container.Overview:
May is a self-hosted vehicle management app: fuel fill-ups with consumption figures (L/100km, MPG), EV charging, expenses and recurring costs, trips, maintenance schedules, reminders, tyres and documents. It handles several vehicles and users (with roles), and offers a REST API, a Home Assistant integration and a calendar feed.
First launch: open the WebUI and sign in as admin. The password is the one set in Admin password; if left empty, a random one is printed once in the container logs on first start. Change it after the first login.
Container.Requires:
Before the first start, create the uploads folder with the right owner from the Unraid terminal, otherwise photos and documents cannot be saved:
mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/may/uploads chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/may

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Admin password, used on first start only (empty: random, shown in the logs)

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Session key (empty: generated in the appdata folder)
